title: Do Benign-Trained Hidden-State Probes Detect Tool Errors Under Adversarial Conditions?
abstract: arXiv:2611.11172v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Repeatedly training language models on their own generated data may create a synthetic-data feedback loop in which errors and distributional biases are reintroduced into subsequent training datasets. This paper studies that process in biomedical question answering (QA) using PubMedQA and two Qwen2.5 model sizes, 0.5B and 3B parameters. The study compares a recursive synthetic-data condition, in which generation G(k+1) is trained on answers produced by G(k), against a Human-Control condition that repeatedly uses the original human training data. The study evaluates across four generations from G0-G3 with two random seeds (42 and 123) and a fixed evaluation set of 1,000 expert-labeled samples. The evaluation includes disease and chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, lexical and semantic similarity, answer length, repetition rate, and other evaluation metrics. translated_title: 良性训练的隐状态探针能否在对抗条件下检测工具错误？
translated_abstract: 反复在语言模型自身生成的数据上进行训练，可能会形成一种合成数据反馈循环，使错误和分布偏差被重新引入后续的训练数据集中。本文使用PubMedQA数据集以及两种规模的Qwen2.5模型（0.5B和3B参数），在生物医学问答（QA）任务中研究这一过程。该研究将递归合成数据条件（即第G(k+1)代模型在第G(k)代模型生成的答案上进行训练）与反复使用原始人工训练数据的人类控制条件进行对比。研究在G0至G3四个代次上，使用两个随机种子（42和123）以及固定的1,000条专家标注样本评估集进行评估。评估指标包括疾病和化学实体F1分数、上下文支持率、词汇与语义相似度、答案长度、重复率等其他评估指标。两种模型规模和两个随机种子下的递归条件均显示出……（原文摘要在此处截断，句子不完整）
tldr: 该论文在生物医学问答任务中通过多代递归实验，首次系统比较了语言模型在自身生成答案上递归训练（合成数据反馈循环）与持续使用人工数据的差异，揭示错误与分布偏差如何随代次累积。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies synthetic-data feedback loops in biomedical QA by recursively training Qwen2.5 models (0.5B and 3B) across four generations on their own generated answers, comparing against human-controlled training to reveal how errors and distributional biases accumulate.
